blocks.text: Executive Chairman, QIS Group Of Institutions

Trained in USA in latest computer Technologies and Software Development, Sri N. Surya Kalyan Chakravarthy is a member of Engineering Society of Detroit (E.S.D.) in Michigan State, U.S.A. Keenly interested in research, he is associated with various scientific and technological Research and Development groups. He is the Founder of SNES, Ongole. Sri N. Surya Kalyan Chakravarthy is the honourable Secretary and Correspondent of SNES. His rich experience with a blend of modern outlook steers SNES to heights.

The Sri Nidamanuri Educational Society was established in the year 1997 to establish educational institutions from Primary to post-graduate level to impart quality education at all stages for the promotion of Engineering, Arts and sciences and other subjects for diffusion of useful knowledge in Prakasam district of Andhra Pradesh.The vibrant interior and exquisite finishing lends the college an ambience that is as delightful and inspiring.

QIS College of Engineering & Technology established in the year 1998 by Sri Nidamanuri Educational Society, is committed to promote technical education in Prakasam District. The College is affiliated to J.N.T. University, Kakinada.

Under this Management, a number of Institutions have been started, and they are flourishing very well. This Society started another Engineering College with the name of QIS Institute of Technology at Vengamukkapalem in Ongole. This College offers courses in B.Tech CSE, ECE, EEE, IT and Mechanical Engineering. The management introduced QIS College of Pharmacy and offers B.Pharm course , M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics) and M.Pharm (Pharmaceutical Analysis & Quality Assurance) to materialize as the dreams of aspiring students and parents.

The Management has also introduced PG courses in this Institution. They offer coaching in M. Tech (C.S.E), M. Tech (C.S.),M. Tech (Power Systems Control & Automation), M.Tech (Power Systems), M. Tech (Power Electronics & Power Systems), M. Tech (Digital Elec. & Comm. Systems), M. Tech (Digital System & Computer Electronics), M. Tech (VLSI & Embedded Systems), M. Tech (Machine Design), M.C.A. & M.B.A.

The Management started a Degree College in 1999 with the name N.N.R. & C.L. Degree College, Ongole. This Institution offers B.Com., B.Sc., course with all traditional and High Tech courses. P.G.Courses in M.Sc., Physics and Chemistry are also started. The Management also started QIS College of Education, which offers B.Ed course at Vengamukkapalem in Ongole.

Besides these Institutions which cater to the needs of higher education this Society has also started a Public School starting from Nursery to 10th Class, under State and Central Syllabus namely QIS High School & QIS Public School. In short, this Management runs from L.K.G. to P.G.
